en.title: Outdoor parcel lockers
en.summary: From an idea on paper to a physical, digital and logistics service.
en.challenge: Expanding online shopping meant offering a more flexible way for customers to collect parcels. The challenge was not just to install a cabinet: hardware, custom software, transport, infrastructure and operational processes had to work together.
en.why: A collection service only works when the customer journey and the behind-the-scenes logistics process are both reliable.
role: Led the initiative from concept through installation
Defined project phases, milestones and requirements
Coordinated technical, operational and external partners
work: Worked with the manufacturer on hardware, software and outdoor construction requirements for the region
Coordinated international transport and site-related implementation activities
Defined the logistics processes for the outdoor locker service
Coordinated custom software and integration requirements with the eCommerce environment
results: Supported implementation of an outdoor collection solution designed for around-the-clock parcel pickup
Connected the physical pickup experience with the software and logistics work needed to operate it
en.lesson: The real product is the complete service, not only the technology people can see.

hr.title: Outdoor paketomati
hr.summary: Od ideje do fizičke, digitalne i logističke usluge.
hr.challenge: Rast online kupnje tražio je fleksibilniji način preuzimanja pošiljaka. Izazov nije bio samo postaviti paketomat: hardver, prilagođeni softver, transport, infrastruktura i operativni procesi morali su raditi kao jedna cjelina.
hr.why: Usluga preuzimanja funkcionira tek kad su i korisnički put i logistički proces u pozadini pouzdani.
role: Vodio inicijativu od koncepta do montaže
Definirao faze projekta, ključne rokove i zahtjeve
Koordinirao tehničke, operativne i vanjske partnere
work: S proizvođačem usklađivao hardver, softver i konstrukcijske zahtjeve za vanjsku upotrebu
Koordinirao međunarodni transport i provedbu na lokacijama
Definirao logističke procese usluge paketomata
Koordinirao zahtjeve prilagođenog softvera i povezivanja s eCommerce okruženjem
results: Sudjelovao u realizaciji rješenja namijenjenog preuzimanju pošiljaka 24 sata dnevno
Povezao fizičko preuzimanje s potrebnim softverskim i logističkim procesima
hr.lesson: Pravi proizvod je cjelokupna usluga, a ne samo tehnologija koju korisnik vidi.

en.title: Enterprise commerce delivery with Spryker
en.summary: Managing priorities and delivery across a modern, integration-heavy eCommerce platform.
en.challenge: Enterprise commerce development needs to reconcile business priorities, platform capabilities, complex integrations and delivery capacity over many iterations.
en.why: Even strong technology underperforms when teams and stakeholders are not aligned on scope, dependencies and measurable user value.
role: E-commerce Project / Product Manager
Owned planning, backlog coordination and stakeholder alignment within delivery scope
Worked closely with engineering and business teams
work: Translated business needs into delivery-ready items and MVP scope
Coordinated releases, sprint-level priorities and integration dependencies
Aligned internal stakeholders and technical teams on constraints and sequencing
Contributed to adapting platform capabilities to real retail and operational processes
results: Managed sustained delivery work on a Spryker-based eCommerce platform
Supported an approach that connected roadmap decisions with implementable work
en.lesson: The most valuable roadmap is one that teams can actually deliver and that solves a business problem.

hr.title: Enterprise eCommerce na Sprykeru
hr.summary: Upravljanje prioritetima i isporukom na modernoj eCommerce platformi s brojnim integracijama.
hr.challenge: Razvoj enterprise trgovine stalno usklađuje poslovne prioritete, mogućnosti platforme, složene integracije i kapacitet timova.
hr.why: Ni dobra tehnologija ne donosi vrijednost ako timovi i dionici nisu usklađeni oko opsega, ovisnosti i koristi za korisnika.
role: eCommerce Project / Product Manager
Odgovornost za planiranje, koordinaciju backloga i dionika unutar opsega isporuke
Bliska suradnja s razvojnim i poslovnim timovima
work: Prevođenje poslovnih potreba u razvojne zadatke i MVP opseg
Koordinacija izdanja, sprint prioriteta i ovisnosti integracija
Usklađivanje poslovnih i tehničkih timova oko ograničenja i redoslijeda
Prilagodba mogućnosti platforme stvarnim retail i operativnim procesima
results: Vodio kontinuiranu isporuku na eCommerce platformi temeljenoj na Sprykeru
Povezivao odluke o roadmapu s izvedivim razvojnim aktivnostima
hr.lesson: Najbolji roadmap je onaj koji tim stvarno može isporučiti i koji rješava poslovni problem.

en.title: Konzum Online — platform relaunch
en.summary: Connecting retail operations and technology behind a refreshed online shopping experience.
en.challenge: A large grocery retailer needed an online platform that could support real-world retail, delivery and store operations, not just an attractive storefront.
en.why: Grocery eCommerce has operational complexity: availability, delivery, picking, checkout and internal systems must remain aligned.
role: Head of eCommerce IT / project lead for the IT scope
Defined business and logistics requirements
Coordinated internal teams, external vendors and development delivery
work: Helped define business and logistics processes for the refreshed Konzum Online solution
Prepared functional documentation for web and mobile features
Coordinated technical teams and integration dependencies
Connected operational stakeholders and software delivery
results: Contributed to the relaunch of the Konzum online shopping platform
Helped establish the process and system requirements supporting web and mobile commerce
en.lesson: A webshop is the visible tip of a much larger retail operating model.

hr.title: Konzum Online — razvoj platforme
hr.summary: Povezivanje maloprodajnih procesa i tehnologije iza modernijeg online iskustva kupnje.
hr.challenge: Velikom maloprodajnom sustavu treba online platforma koja podržava stvarne procese trgovina, dostave i skladišta, a ne samo dobar izgled webshopa.
hr.why: Online kupnja namirnica operativno je složena: raspoloživost, dostava, priprema narudžbi, plaćanje i interni sustavi moraju biti povezani.
role: Voditelj IT-a za eCommerce / voditelj IT dijela projekta
Definirao poslovne i logističke zahtjeve
Koordinirao interne timove, dobavljače i razvoj
work: Sudjelovao u definiranju poslovnih i logističkih procesa novog Konzum Online rješenja
Pripremao funkcionalnu dokumentaciju za web i mobilne funkcionalnosti
Koordinirao tehničke timove i integracije
Povezivao operativne dionike i isporuku softvera
results: Sudjelovao u relaunchu platforme za online kupnju
Pomogao definirati procese i sistemske zahtjeve za web i mobilnu trgovinu
hr.lesson: Webshop je samo vidljivi dio puno većeg operativnog modela maloprodaje.

en.title: Retail recommendation engine
en.summary: Working on personalized product recommendations using existing retail and loyalty data.
en.challenge: Turning retail data into useful product suggestions requires business understanding, usable data and implementation across customer-facing commerce experiences.
en.why: Recommendation logic can only help customers when it reflects real shopping behavior and fits naturally into the commerce experience.
role: Responsible for the eCommerce implementation component
Participated in defining calculation logic using available data
Connected business requirements and technical execution
work: Collaborated on the logic for calculating recommendations from existing data
Defined and coordinated the eCommerce-side implementation needs
Connected loyalty and retail context with the digital experience
results: Contributed to the implementation of a data-driven recommendation solution within the eCommerce environment
en.lesson: Personalization is a product decision as much as it is a data or engineering problem.

hr.title: Recommendation engine u retailu
hr.summary: Personalizirane preporuke proizvoda na temelju postojećih maloprodajnih i loyalty podataka.
hr.challenge: Pretvoriti podatke maloprodaje u korisne preporuke zahtijeva razumijevanje poslovanja, kvalitetu dostupnih podataka i implementaciju unutar digitalnog kanala.
hr.why: Logika preporuka korisna je tek kada prati stvarno ponašanje u kupnji i prirodno se uklapa u webshop.
role: Odgovoran za eCommerce dio implementacije
Sudjelovao u definiranju logike izračuna na postojećim podacima
Povezivao poslovne potrebe i tehničku realizaciju
work: Sudjelovao u osmišljavanju logike preporuka iz dostupnih podataka
Definirao i koordinirao zahtjeve implementacije u eCommerce kanalu
Povezivao loyalty i retail kontekst s korisničkim iskustvom
results: Sudjelovao u implementaciji podatkovno vođenog recommendation rješenja u eCommerce sustavu
hr.lesson: Personalizacija je jednako produktna odluka kao što je podatkovni i tehnički problem.

en.title: Self-service help portal for employees
en.summary: A digital knowledge and support channel designed to make everyday operations easier.
en.challenge: Employees needed a more accessible way to find answers, support information and updates about internal applications and retail processes.
en.why: Repeated support requests consume time on both sides. A searchable, accessible knowledge hub can reduce unnecessary handoffs.
role: Contributed to the definition and rollout of an internal self-service portal
Worked across IT support, knowledge sharing and operational workflows
work: Helped establish a portal for FAQs, manuals, business application updates and employee support
Connected everyday user questions to a self-service experience
Supported the design of processes that reduce repetitive support work
results: The published project description reports 40% fewer IT support requests in the following months
Created an information channel available to employees across devices on the internal network
en.lesson: Sometimes the best digital product is the one that removes friction from dozens of small daily tasks.

hr.title: Self-service portal za zaposlenike
hr.summary: Digitalni kanal znanja i podrške za jednostavniji svakodnevni rad.
hr.challenge: Zaposlenicima je trebao jednostavniji pristup uputama, podršci i informacijama o internim aplikacijama i poslovnim procesima.
hr.why: Ponavljajući zahtjevi za podrškom troše vrijeme. Dobra baza znanja i samouslužni portal mogu smanjiti nepotrebne korake.
role: Sudjelovao u definiranju i uvođenju internog samouslužnog portala
Povezivao IT podršku, dijeljenje znanja i operativne procese
work: Uspostava portala s čestim pitanjima, uputama, obavijestima i podrškom zaposlenicima
Povezivanje svakodnevnih pitanja sa self-service iskustvom
Definiranje procesa koji smanjuju ponavljajući rad podrške
results: U javno objavljenom opisu projekta navedeno je 40% manje zahtjeva prema IT podršci tijekom sljedećih mjeseci
Uspostavljen informacijski kanal dostupan zaposlenicima s različitih uređaja unutar interne mreže
hr.lesson: Ponekad je najbolji digitalni proizvod onaj koji uklanja desetke malih svakodnevnih prepreka.

en.title: PICKUP — groceries click & collect
en.summary: Online ordering, in-store collection and a shopping journey that crosses channels.
en.challenge: Allow customers to place grocery orders online and collect them at a convenient store and time.
en.why: Click & Collect connects digital checkout with availability, picking, store operations and customer communication.
role: Member of the team defining business and logistics processes
Project manager for the IT scope
Coordinated internal and external teams
work: Helped define ordering and collection processes
Coordinated IT implementation across relevant systems and partners
Contributed to digital experience design and web delivery
results: Contributed to a pickup service that connected online grocery orders with physical stores
en.lesson: Omnichannel works only when the channel boundaries disappear for the customer.

hr.title: POKUPI — preuzimanje namirnica
hr.summary: Online narudžba i preuzimanje u trgovini kao jedinstveno kupovno iskustvo.
hr.challenge: Omogućiti narudžbu namirnica online i preuzimanje u odabranoj trgovini i terminu.
hr.why: Click & Collect povezuje checkout s raspoloživošću, pripremom narudžbe, procesima trgovine i komunikacijom s kupcem.
role: Član tima koji je definirao poslovne i logističke procese
Voditelj IT dijela projekta
Koordinirao interne i vanjske timove

Koordinirao IT realizaciju kroz povezane sustave i partnere
Sudjelovao u oblikovanju digitalnog iskustva i web razvoja
results: Doprinos usluzi koja povezuje online narudžbe namirnica s fizičkim trgovinama
hr.lesson: Omnichannel radi kada korisnik više ne osjeća granice između kanala.

en.title: Zdravoljupci — digital loyalty
en.summary: Bringing a large consumer loyalty initiative into the online shopping journey.
en.challenge: A campaign spanning physical retail and families needed a coherent digital loyalty experience within the webshop.
en.why: Loyalty programs need well-defined rules, business processes and digital journeys to be useful online.
role: Member of the core process-definition team
Project management for the IT / online-commerce scope
work: Helped define business and logistics requirements for the digital loyalty experience
Coordinated internal and external teams involved in online implementation
Aligned campaign requirements with existing webshop processes
results: Contributed to bringing the Zdravoljupci loyalty experience into the digital shopping channel
en.lesson: Promotions become products when the underlying rules and customer experience are designed together.

hr.title: Zdravoljupci — digitalni loyalty
hr.summary: Povezivanje velike loyalty kampanje s iskustvom online kupnje.
hr.challenge: Kampanja koja spaja fizičku maloprodaju i obitelji trebala je jasno digitalno iskustvo unutar webshopa.
hr.why: Loyalty programi na internetu trebaju precizna pravila, procese i korisničke putove.

Voditelj IT / eCommerce dijela projekta
work: Sudjelovao u definiranju poslovnih i logističkih zahtjeva za digitalni loyalty
Koordinirao interne i vanjske timove u online implementaciji
Usklađivao kampanjske zahtjeve s procesima webshopa
results: Sudjelovao u uključivanju Zdravoljubaca u digitalni kupovni kanal
hr.lesson: Promocija postaje proizvod tek kada pravila i korisničko iskustvo rade zajedno.

hr.challenge: Uključiti partnerski program pogodnosti u postojeći sustav online maloprodaje na razumljiv način.
hr.why: Pogodnosti lako gube smisao ako bodovi, narudžbe, korisnički podaci i operativna pravila nisu usklađeni.

results: Sudjelovao u realizaciji loyalty iskustva na Konzum webshopu

Worked on user-centered requirements and delivery priorities

hr.why: Vizualna konzistentnost je važna, ali jednako važna je usklađenost s poslovnim potrebama i dugoročnim održavanjem.
role: Koordinirao produktne i implementacijske dionike
Radio na korisničkim zahtjevima i prioritetima isporuke
work: Sudjelovao u definiranju promjena prikaza proizvoda, naslovnice i checkouta
Usklađivao dizajn s backend ovisnostima i poslovnim zahtjevima
Podržavao koordinaciju implementacije na eCommerce sustavu
results: Sudjelovao u modernizaciji korisničkog sučelja s ciljem primjene na više eKupi webshopova
hr.lesson: Poboljšanja upotrebljivosti traju kada se dizajn i operativna ograničenja razmatraju zajedno.

en.title: Commerce infrastructure on AWS
en.summary: Linking cloud migration work with the needs of a large retail eCommerce operation.

hr.title: eCommerce infrastruktura na AWS-u
hr.summary: Povezivanje cloud migracije s potrebama velikog retail eCommerce sustava.
hr.challenge: Premještanje online maloprodajnog sustava u cloud traži razumijevanje operativnih potreba i ovisnosti, a ne samo servera.

Voditelj IT / poslovnog dijela zahtjeva

en.title: Insurance web & mobile self-service
en.summary: Connecting customer journeys, accessibility and product delivery in a regulated environment.
en.challenge: Insurance self-service experiences involve varied products, user needs and business processes. Changes must remain accessible, consistent and feasible to deliver.
en.why: Digital insurance should reduce customer effort rather than simply move complex processes online.

Business and development stakeholder coordination
Prioritization of digital improvements
work: Worked on web and mobile customer journeys across insurance products

results: Supported continued improvement of customer-facing insurance digital channels
en.lesson: A digital channel creates value when it makes a real-world task easier for the person using it.

hr.title: Web i mobilni self-service u osiguranju

Koordinacija poslovnih i razvojnih dionika
Prioritizacija digitalnih poboljšanja
work: Rad na web i mobilnim korisničkim putovima više proizvoda osiguranja
Definiranje backloga i koordinacija isporuke
Povezivanje analitike, pristupačnosti, sadržaja i SEO-a s korisničkim iskustvom
Suradnja na poboljšanjima digitalne kupnje i samousluge
results: Doprinos kontinuiranom razvoju digitalnih kanala za korisnike osiguranja
hr.lesson: Digitalni kanal stvara vrijednost kada osobi olakšava stvarni zadatak.

en.title: Insurance process automation

en.why: A reliable automation is not the one that handles only the ideal scenario, but the one that makes boundaries, exceptions and handoffs explicit.
role: Business/process analysis and cross-team coordination

Coordinated clarification of inputs, outputs and exceptions

Supported communication between process owners and technical delivery

en.lesson: Process clarity is a prerequisite for meaningful automation.

hr.title: Automatizacija procesa u osiguranju
hr.summary: Prevođenje složenih operativnih postupaka u jasne zahtjeve i MVP granice automatizacije.
hr.challenge: Administrativni procesi često spajaju više sustava, vrsta dokumenata i iznimki. Prije automatizacije važno je usuglasiti stvarni tijek rada.
hr.why: Pouzdana automatizacija nije samo idealni scenarij: treba definirati iznimke, granice i mjesta predaje čovjeku.

Definiranje opsega automatizacije i MVP-a
work: Mapiranje procesa i sistemskih ovisnosti na poslovnoj razini
Razjašnjavanje ulaza, izlaza i iznimki
Definiranje razumnih MVP točaka zaustavljanja i predaje
Komunikacija između vlasnika procesa i tehničkog tima
results: Doprinos definiranju provedivog opsega automatizacije; javni operativni rezultati nisu objavljeni
hr.lesson: Jasan proces preduvjet je smislene automatizacije.
